claims.claim: Added an explicitly invoked source-binding API in review_transport that composes authenticated semantic documents through the existing TASK-376 and VP-02 validators without active admission or scheduling integration.

The API checks configured remote identity and expected main before and after observation, authenticates commit/tree/path/blob identities and content, and derives TASK identity, revision, envelope digest and complete acceptance from committed TASK bytes.

Implemented fail-closed checks for ambiguous or wrong remotes, moved main, unanchored commits, stale paths, mismatched objects, contradictory declarations, duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8 and oversized input.

The immutable observation records exact Git provenance while retaining unestablished approval, semantic review, verification, applicability and production authority, with execution disabled and KA-01 NOT_ACTIVATED.

Added synthetic local-Git fixture tests covering exact sources, reorder stability, forged and stale identities, remote replay, main movement, strict decoding, write traps and historical transport compatibility.
Added bounded documentation explaining source authentication, trust limits and outstanding L1, VP-01, L2/L3 and G3/G6 dependencies.
Committed only the three permitted files; no lifecycle integration, historical mutation, roadmap change or activation was introduced.
